note: Invented sample answers of the Linear, Slack and Notion connectors, for the demo mode of the PRD Builder (the same shapes the connectors return).

linear.title: Kanban view of the pipeline by stage
linear.description:
As a seller I want a kanban view of my pipeline by stage so that I see where deals get stuck.

Acceptance criteria
- One column per stage
- Dragging a deal changes its stage
- Totals per column

linear.title: Forecast by quarter
linear.description:
As a sales manager I want the forecast by quarter so that I can plan the team.

Acceptance criteria
- Weighted and unweighted value
- Filter by owner

linear.title: Offline notes on the phone
linear.description: Sellers write notes after a visit without network and sync later.

linear.title: Export a customer list to CSV
linear.description: As an account executive I want to export a list so that I can share it.

messages.text: Three customers this week asked for a way to see all open offers of an account on one page. Right now we click through four screens.
The quarterly forecast is still built by hand in a sheet. If the app could do it, <@U01SELLER> and I would save half a day every month.
Mobile: notes after a visit get lost because there is no signal in the factory halls. Offline would help a lot, see <https://linear.example/SAL-47|SAL-47>.
Please keep the discount approval simple. More than two steps and nobody will use it.

notion.title: Quarterly planning: Sales Companion
notion.text:
# Goals
- Reduce the time to prepare a customer meeting from 45 to 15 minutes
- One place for offers, contracts and open tickets of an account

# Customer requests
Two key accounts asked for a read-only portal view of their offers and contracts. They do not want to call their account executive for status.

# Risks
The data of contracts and offers sits in two systems. Until they are connected, numbers in the app can differ from the contract system by a few days.

# Notes
ok
